subject: Mid-q lead sync: OKR coverage, re-scope proposals & blocker resolution
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-q lead check: OKR coverage, proposed re-scope & dependency asks

Team & Alicia —

Quick mid-quarter status and asks ahead of the QBR pack cut next week. High level: pillars for the quarter are on track overall but we have concentrated risk in two areas that need rapid alignment so the QBR narrative is honest and actionable. I've attached a heatmap (2026-07-15_okr_heatmap.xlsx) and a one-pager draft for the QBR.

Top signals:
- Latency OKR (Pillar A): token p50/p95 improving but tail latency on large-batch workloads still +2x target for select customers.
- Cost optimization (Pillar B): early quantization rollouts look promising but regression rate on hallucination tests rose 3 percentage points in the latest eval set.

Asks / proposed re-scope: 
1) Vanessa: propose trimming nonessential UX experiments in Aug to free 0.5 FTE of SWE for infra rework (~3 weeks of runway).
2) Karthik: need a decision on dedicating a small GPU pool for deterministic tail testing (estimate: 2x A100 for 3 weeks).
3) Priya: confirm whether we can postpone the multi-region routing beta to reduce cross-region complexity from the QBR narrative.

External ask for Acme (Alicia): we want to include a short note on your pilot success and any concerns — if you can share the security checklist back to us before Mon that helps answer procurement questions in the deck.

Attachments: 2026-07-15_okr_heatmap.xlsx (xlsx), draft_qbr_onepager.pdf (pdf)

I'll collect commitments by end of day Monday and produce a trimmed QBR slide set for review on Wed.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q lead check: OKR coverage, proposed re-scope & dependency asks

On Thu, Jul 15, 2026 at 09:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team & Alicia —
> 
> Quick mid-quarter status and asks ahead of the QBR pack cut next week...

Thanks, Rishi. Short answers and commitment levels below: 

- UX experiments: I agree to pause the personalization A/B and the multivariate landing test. That frees ~0.4 FTE on my side and the PM can reassign to infra support. Owner: Vanessa; target handoff 2026-07-21.
- Multi-region routing beta: I recommend pausing the public beta; we keep the internal canary for metrics. Priya, can you confirm ops impact?

Open for infra: we can sponsor the deterministic tail testing but need Karthik to confirm exact infra hours and whether we can get burst capacity rather than reserved.

Vanessa
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@acme-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mid-q lead check: OKR coverage, proposed re-scope & dependency asks

Thanks for the update, Rishi and team. Quick responses from Acme side:
- We can push the formal procurement gating to Aug 5 if that helps the deck.
- Attached is our filled security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_acme.pdf). It includes the SOC-2 scope items we need visibility into.
- For the QBR blurb: we will be candid about tail latency but emphasize the improvements since pilot start. Happy to provide a 2–3 sentence quote for the slide.

Alicia Gomez
Head of Data Partnerships
Acme Analytics
Attachment: security_questionnaire_acme.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q lead check: OKR coverage, proposed re-scope & dependency asks

Rishi —

Appreciate the framing. A few technical clarifications and a narrow ask: 

1) Deterministic tail testing: the simplest path is a 2x A100 burst (spot-like) staged for 2 weeks. We can run the large-batch tail matrix and KV cache permutations. Cost estimate: ~$18k (cloud burst) or equivalent in dedicated reserved credits.
2) Quantization regressions: I traced the eval failures to a specific model config (q4_compat_v2) used in experimental routing. I can produce a quick patch but it needs 48–72 hours of test time on the tail testing pool.

If Vanessa can free the 0.4 FTE and Priya confirms the routing beta pause, I can commit to the patch and the test plan. Otherwise the QBR will have to call out a follow-up remediation.

-Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@acme-analytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir@saasco.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q lead check: OKR coverage, proposed re-scope & dependency asks — final commitments + MAP

Thanks for the quick turns. Finalizing commitments so I can update the QBR narrative: 

Agreed commits:
- Vanessa: pause UX experiments; handoff complete by 2026-07-21.
- Priya: approve pausing multi-region public beta; Ops impact acknowledged (Priya to confirm rollback playbook by 2026-07-20).
- Karthik: run patch + deterministic tail test on 2x A100 burst pool; begin 2026-07-20; estimated run end 2026-08-02. Cost approval: we will use reserved burst credits (charge to infra Q3 budget).
- Acme (Alicia): procurement push to Aug 5 and security questionnaire received. Rishi to follow up with legal for SOC-2 clarifications.

I've assembled a short mutual action plan and uploaded it here: https://hubspot.com/deal/HD-8923-map (mutual_action_plan_v1.docx). Please review today and add owners/notes. I'll cut the QBR pack on Wed and circulate for comments. If anything deviates from the above by EOD tomorrow, flag here so I can adjust the slide narrative.

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx, draft_qbr_onepager.pdf

Cheers —
Rishi
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
